elements.description:
The shape of a model's structured answer, built as a tree of fields beside a rendered preview of the answer, its
raw JSON and the JSON Schema it makes.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The output object's fields, in order. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading – what the output is for

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quieter line under the heading

properties.name: preview
properties.description: What the preview shows: the rendered answer ("output"), its raw JSON ("sample") or the JSON Schema ("schema")

properties.name: flat
properties.description: Drops the tray and the card, for a builder inside another card

properties.name: name
properties.description: Submitted with the form: the generated JSON Schema, as JSON

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Turns editing off and leaves the schema out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

properties.name: schema
properties.description: The JSON Schema the fields generate

properties.name: sample
properties.description: A sample object of the schema's shape

properties.name: issues
properties.description: Every problem with the fields, errors and warnings

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The fields changed ({ value: OutputSchemaField[] }); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-preview-change
events.description: Output, JSON or Schema was picked ({ preview: "output" | "sample" | "schema" }); cancelable

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Whether the fields make a valid schema (no errors; warnings are fine)

functions.name: schemaIssues
functions.description: Every problem in the tree, depth first: missing or repeated names, empty or repeated allowed values, empty objects

functions.name: schemaFieldError
functions.description: The first error's message, or "" when the fields make a valid schema

functions.name: schemaFromFields
functions.description: The JSON Schema for an object with these fields: every object closed (additionalProperties: false)

functions.name: sampleFromFields
functions.description: A sample object of this shape: the first allowed value, "text", 1.5, 1, true; one item per list

functions.name: validateOutputSample
functions.signature: validateOutputSample(value: unknown, schema: OutputJsonSchema, path: unknown, depth: unknown): string[]
functions.description: Checks a value against a schema from schemaFromFields; one message per problem, "$.path: …"

props.name: title
props.description: The heading – what the output is for

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The fields to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with every change to the fields

props.name: preview
props.description: What the preview shows (controlled): the rendered answer ("output"), its raw JSON ("sample") or the JSON Schema ("schema")

props.name: defaultPreview
props.description: What the preview shows first when uncontrolled

props.name: onPreviewChange
props.description: Called when Output, JSON or Schema is picked
